title: The legend of Black Cave
introduction: The legend of Black Cave is informed to Hanuma and others by Swayamprabha, the sainted lady who safeguards the paradisaical creation of a demon named Maya. Maya crafted this cave as a heaven on earth, for which the infuriated Indra eliminated Maya. Hema, an apsara, nymphal-virtuoso accords this fantastic creation to Swayamprabha. Swayamprabha offers hospitality to all the monkeys who entered that cave.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे एक पंचाशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 51st chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
इति उक्त्वा हनुमान् तत्र पुनः कृष्ण अजिन अंबराम् |
अब्रवीत् ताम् महाभागाम् तापसीम् धर्म चारिणीम्
verses.iast:
iti uktvā hanumān tatra punaḥ kṛṣṇa ajina ambarām |
abravīt tām mahābhāgām tāpasīm dharma cāriṇīm
verses.translation: Thus, Hanuma on saying therein [that subject,] again spoke to that most reverential and sainted lady who is dressed in black deerskin and conducting herself in probity.

glosses.meaning: again, to one with black deer, skin, dressed in
spoke, to her, most reverential lady
sainted lady, in probity, conducting herself.

verses.devanagari:
इदम् प्रविष्टाः सहसा बिलम् तिमिर संवृतम् |
क्षुत् पिपासा परिश्रांताः परिखिन्नाः च सर्वशः
verses.iast:
idam praviṣṭāḥ sahasā bilam timira saṃvṛtam |
kṣut pipāsā pariśrāṃtāḥ parikhinnāḥ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Overtired with hunger and thirst we are overawed anywise, and we suddenly entered this cavity, which is overspread with darkness..." [Thus Hanuma is speaking to her.]

verses.devanagari:
महत् धरण्या विवरम् प्रविष्टाः स्म पिपासिताः |
इमाम् तु एवम् विधान् भावान् विविधान् अद्भुत उपमान्
दृष्ट्वा वयम् प्रव्यथिताः संभ्रांता नष्ट चेतसः |
कस्य एते कांचना वृक्षाः तरुण आदित्य सन्निभाः
verses.iast:
mahat dharaṇyā vivaram praviṣṭāḥ sma pipāsitāḥ |
imām tu evam vidhān bhāvān vividhān adbhuta upamān
dṛṣṭvā vayam pravyathitāḥ sambhrāṃtā naṣṭa cetasaḥ |
kasya ete kāṃcanā vṛkṣāḥ taruṇa āditya sannibhāḥ
verses.translation: "We entered this extensive hollow of earth thirstily, but on seeing this kind of these diverse and marvellous mansions we are verily amazed [presuming that this is a dominion of some demon,] and we are agitated [in not knowing dos and don'ts,] and agonised [at our incarceration...] whose trees are all these golden ones, splendent like young sun...

glosses.meaning: these, but, this, kind of, mansion

glosses.itrans: dR^iSTvaa vayam pravyathitaaH sambhraantaa naSTa cetasaH
glosses.iast: dṛṣṭvā vayam pravyathitāḥ sambhrāntā naṣṭa cetasaḥ
glosses.devanagari: दृष्ट्वा वयं प्रव्यथिताः सम्भ्रान्ता नष्ट चेतसः
glosses.meaning: on seeing, we are, verily agitated, verily amazed, lost, hearts [agonised]

verses.devanagari:
शुचीनि अभ्यवहार्याणि मूलानि च फलानि च |
कांचनानि विमानानि राजतानि गृहाणि च
तपनीय गव अक्षाणि मणि जाल आवृतानि च |
verses.iast:
śucīni abhyavahār.hyāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca |
kāṃcanāni vimānāni rājatāni gṛhāṇi ca
tapanīya gava akṣāṇi maṇi jāla āvṛtāni ca |
verses.translation: "The edibles, tubers, and fruits are all depurated... golden are the aircrafts... mansions silvern... ventilators golden and encased in jewelly laces...

verses.devanagari:
पुष्पिताः फालवन्तः च पुण्याः सुरभि गन्धयः
इमे जांबूनदमयाः पादपाः कस्य तेजसा |
verses.iast:
puṣpitāḥ phālavantaḥ ca puṇyāḥ surabhi gandhayaḥ
ime jāmbūnadamayāḥ pādapāḥ kasya tejasā |
verses.translation: "Flowered and fruited and also aromatically scented are these auspicious and completely golden trees... by whose splendour [they are rendered thus?]

verses.devanagari:
कांचनानि च पद्मानि जातानि विमले जले
कथम् मत्स्याः च सौवर्णा दृश्यन्ते सह कच्छपैः |
verses.iast:
kāṃcanāni ca padmāni jātāni vimale jale
katham matsyāḥ ca sauvarṇā dṛśyante saha kacchapaiḥ |
verses.translation: "Also how the lotuses born in limpid water are golden, and how the fishes along with tortoises are ostensibly golden?

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानः अनुभावात् वा कस्य वै एतत् तपो बलम्
अजानताम् नः सर्वेषाम् सर्वम् आख्यातुम् अर्हसि |
verses.iast:
ātmānaḥ anubhāvāt vā kasya vai etat tapo balam
ajānatām naḥ sarveṣām sarvam ākhyātum ar.hhasi |
verses.translation: "Or, is all this owing to the innate prodigy of yours or to whose ascesis' prowess all this is owed... as all of us are oblivious of it, so it will be apt of you to narrate all of it..." [Thus Hanuma requested that sainted lady.]

glosses.meaning: of yours, innate, owing to prodigy, or
whose, indeed, all this, ascesis', prowess
not, knowing [oblivious of,] us, all of
all of it, to narrate, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता हनुमता तापसी धर्म चारिणी
प्रति उवाच हनूमंतम् सर्व भूत हिते रता |
verses.iast:
evam uktā hanumatā tāpasī dharma cāriṇī
prati uvāca hanūmaṃtam sarva bhūta hite ratā |
verses.translation: Thus when Hanuma addressed her, that sainted lady, and a blissful one in the well being of all the beings, she replied Hanuma.

glosses.meaning: thus, she is addressed, by Hanuma
all, beings, in well-being, blissful one.

verses.devanagari:
मयो नाम महातेजा मायावी दानवर्षभः
तेन इदम् निर्मितम् सर्वम् मायया कांचनम् वनम् |
verses.iast:
mayo nāma mahātejā māyāvī dānavarṣabhaḥ
tena idam nirmitam sarvam māyayā kāṃcanam vanam |
verses.translation: "A marvellous fantasist by name Maya was there, a bullish demon of wizardry and by him with his phenomenal expertise all this golden woodland is constructed..." [Thus, that sainted lady started her narration.]

glosses.meaning: Maya, named, great-resplendent one [a marvellous fantasist] [was there]
all this, with expertise in illusiveness [phenomenal expertise,] golden, woodland.

verses.devanagari:
पुरा दानव मुख्यानाम् विश्वकर्मा बभूव ह
येन इदम् कांचनम् दिव्यम् निर्मितम् भवन उत्तमम् |
verses.iast:
purā dānava mukhyānām viśvakarmā babhūva ha
yena idam kāṃcanam divyam nirmitam bhavana uttamam |
verses.translation: "Once he was the Universal Craftsman to the lords of demons by whom this divinely golden and superb mansion was constructed...

verses.devanagari:
स तु वर्ष सहस्राणि तपः तप्त्वा महत् वने
पितामहात् वरम् लेभे सर्वम् औशसनम् धनम् |
verses.iast:
sa tu varṣa sahasrāṇi tapaḥ taptvā mahat vane
pitāmahāt varam lebhe sarvam auśasanam dhanam |
verses.translation: "But he on practising ascesis for thousands of years in this horrendous forest, obtained a boon from Brahma, the Forefather, [which entails acquirement of] entire wealth of Sage Shukra...

glosses.meaning: ascesis, on practising, in [this] horrendous, forest
entire, of Sage Shukra, wealth [the architecture or, the wealth of immoderate beseechers of wealth.]

verses.devanagari:
विधाय सर्वम् बलवान् सर्व काम ईश्वरः तदा
उवास सुखितः कालम् कंचित् अस्मिन् महावने |
verses.iast:
vidhāya sarvam balavān sarva kāma īśvaraḥ tadā
uvāsa sukhitaḥ kālam kañcit asmin mahāvane |
verses.translation: "That dynamic one methodised everything and then resided comfortably in this great forest for some time, privileged with all his wishes...

glosses.meaning: all, wishes, ruler of [invested with privileges for all wishes,] then
time, some, in this, great, forest.

verses.devanagari:
तम् अप्सरसि हेमायाम् सक्तम् दानव पुंगवम्
विक्रम्य एव अशनिम् गृह्य जघान ईशः पुरंदरः |
verses.iast:
tam apsarasi hemāyām saktam dānava puṃgavam
vikramya eva aśanim gṛhya jaghāna īśaḥ puraṃdaraḥ |
verses.translation: "Indra, the Administrator of Worlds and destroyer of enemy citadels, on taking His Thunderbolt eliminated Maya, when that eminent demon was engaged with an apsara, a paradisiacal nymph, called Hema...

glosses.meaning: him [demon Maya,] in apsara, [the paradisiacal nymph,] with Hema, engaged with
eliminated, administrator [of worlds,] enemy-strongholds destroyer, namely Indra.

verses.devanagari:
इदम् च ब्रह्मणा दत्तम् हेमायै वनम् उत्तमम्
शाश्वतः काम भोगः च गृहम् च इदम् हिरण्मयम् |
verses.iast:
idam ca brahmaṇā dattam hemāyai vanam uttamam
śāśvataḥ kāma bhogaḥ ca gṛham ca idam hiraṇmayam |
verses.translation: "This marvellous woodland, these everlasting wish-fulfillers, and this golden mansion, are beneficed by Brahma for Hema...

glosses.meaning: this one, also, by Brahma, beneficed

verses.devanagari:
दुहिता मेरुसावर्णेः अहम् तस्याः स्वयंप्रभा
इदम् रक्षामि भवनम् हेमाया वानरोत्तम |
verses.iast:
duhitā merusāvarṇeḥ aham tasyāḥ svayamprabhā
idam rakṣāmi bhavanam hemāyā vānarottama |
verses.translation: "I am the daughter of Merusaavarni, oh, best monkey, named Swayamprabha and I am safeguarding this mansion of her, [that apsara] Hema...

glosses.meaning: of her [of that apsara,] Swayamprabha named [meaning Self-Splendent]

verses.devanagari:
मम प्रिय सखी हेमा नृत्त गीत विशारदा
तया दत्त वरा च अस्मि रक्षामि भवनम् महान् |
verses.iast:
mama priya sakhī hemā nṛtta gīta viśāradā
tayā datta varā ca asmi rakṣāmi bhavanam mahān |
verses.translation: "Hema is a virtuoso in dance and music and my dearest nymphean-friend, and she bestowed a boon upon me [by which none can dishonour me, and thus] I am safeguarding this superb mansion...
notes: The Universal Architect is given the title of viśva karma and he will be proficient, right from the skills of a blacksmith to that of an outstanding engineer. His works are always guided and as directed by Indra. Indra's logic is that there shall be one viśva karma in all three worlds, like one Indra to three worlds. But whenever Indra lies low, the demons get works done through the heavenly viśva karma, instead of appointing their own architect as their clan-priest Shukraacaarya's treasure of architecture is lost. This treasure of architecture of Shukraacaarya is usurped by this demon Maya, through Brahma. As Indra cannot defy the boon of Brahma, he baited this Hema, the apsara, to make Maya to woo her. Accordingly, demon Maya brought the nymphal-virtuoso Hema to this cavernous paradisiacal mansion and was subjected to elimination by Indra. After the elimination of this Wonder Architect, Hema departed to Brahma's abode, bequeathing this mansion to Swayamprabha. From then on Hema resided in brahma loka 'Brahma's abode...' as said at: ghṛtācīm atha viśvācīm.... nāga datam ca hemām ca... in Ayodhya part II, Ch. 91, verse 17. When Sage Bharadwaja gave hospitality to Bharata, that sage says this.

glosses.meaning: by her, bestowed, boon, also, I am

verses.devanagari:
किम् कार्यम् कस्य वा हेतोः कांताराणि प्रपद्यथ
कथम् च इदम् वनम् दुर्गम् युष्माभिः उपलक्षितम् |
verses.iast:
kim kāryam kasya vā hetoḥ kāṃtārāṇi prapadyatha
katham ca idam vanam durgam yuṣmābhiḥ upalakṣitam |
verses.translation: "What is your effort or for what reason you came to pass this impervious forest, and how you all have discovered this impassable forest...

verses.devanagari:
शुचीनि अभ्यवहार्याणि मूलानि च फलानि च |
भुक्त्वा पीत्वा च पानीयम् सर्वम् मे वक्तुम् अर्हथ
verses.iast:
śucīni abhyavahār.hyāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca |
bhuktvā pītvā ca pānīyam sarvam me vaktum arhatha
verses.translation: "Dine on these wholesome edibles, fruits and tubers, also on drinking soft drinks, it is apt of you to inform me all about [your mission..." Thus Swayamprabha gave hospitality to the monkeys.]

glosses.meaning: about all, to me, to say [inform,] apt of you.
